thread:
carla: Heads-up — patched aws-kms-client 2.3.7 -> 2.3.8 to address CVE-2026-0420. The update changes how key identifiers are sent (alias vs id). Rolling a tiny canary (2%) to prod-us-west now. Will watch audit logs, RBAC effects, and latency.

deploy-bot: deploy started for service:key-proxy @carla — rollout 2% -> 100% over 60m (build 2026.3.8).

ben: nice. quick reminder: our IAM condition uses kms:ViaService with RequestKeyId — might miss alias field. we should add condition that permits kms:RequestAlias or update the mapping.

carla: on it. pushed an infra tweak to allow both RequestAlias and RequestKeyId in the kms policy condition. PR: https://git/repo/infra/pulls/345 (small change to roles/key-proxy-prod)

jen: can we validate CloudTrail / audit logs show Decrypt events mapped to the correct service principal after the change? also would like an alert if requestParameters.alias is missing for a Decrypt.

morgan: quick smoke after 10m: no errors in key-proxy, audit events show Decrypt with alias present. sample CloudTrail line:
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-02-15T14:12:08Z",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "userIdentity": {"arn": "arn:aws:iam::12345:role/key-proxy-prod"},
  "requestParameters": {"keyId": "alias/redwood/main"}
}
```
latency: p50 +5ms, p95 +9ms vs baseline. No spike in errors.

carla: monitoring query I used (Splunk):
`index=kms_logs eventName=Decrypt | stats p50(duration_ms) as p50 p95(duration_ms) as p95 by host`

ben: any regressions in token-service? that one previously spiked when kms client changed in staging.

morgan: token-service metrics look fine: memory +0, cpu flat. perf test at 1k rps passed: rps 980, avg latency 42ms vs baseline 39ms. error rate unchanged.

sec-bot: CVE-2026-0420 severity=HIGH. Affects aws-kms-client <=2.3.7. Fix included in 2.3.8. Advisory: https://sec.advisories/CVE-2026-0420

carla: proposed plan: keep rollout at 2% for another 30m, then 20% for 1h if stable, then continue to 100%. Triggers for immediate rollback: error_rate > 1% OR p95 latency increase > 30% OR missing audit alias fields > 0. Rollback command if needed:
```
./deploy rollback key-proxy --to-build 2026.3.7
```

ben: added a quick canary dashboard panel with a synthetic decrypt trace, audit event count, and latency compare. Shared with the channel. ping me if you need editing rights.

carla: perfect. tagging @oncall for a 30m watch window. please react with :thumbsup: once you're watching. thanks team.
